emails.subject: Riverside audit fieldwork timing
emails.body:
Hi Mei,

Thanks again for helping with the fieldwork items. We are closing the binder at 4:30 p.m. today, so whenever you can, please send back the transaction dates for the full fieldwork window — January 1 through May 31, 2026 — covering all of your activity for the period.

No need to make it fancy on my account — whatever format is easiest on your end works perfectly for me.

Best,
Nadia

emails.subject: Reminder: Q2 all-hands moved to Thursday 3 p.m.
emails.body:
Hi everyone,

A quick reminder that the Q2 all-hands has moved to this Thursday at 3:00 p.m. in the main hall. Remote folks can use the usual video link. Light refreshments will be provided afterward.

Thanks,
Facilities
